problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate a fleet of delivery vehicles from distribution centers to retail outlets to minimize total fuel expenditure.

The number of vehicles stationed at each distribution center (set C) is as follows:
*C1 has 151 vehicles.
*C2 has 133 vehicles.
*C3 has 57 vehicles.
*C4 has 119 vehicles.
*C5 has 165 vehicles.
*C6 has 175 vehicles.
*C7 has 108 vehicles.
*C8 has 141 vehicles.

The required number of vehicles at each retail outlet (set D) is specified below:
*D1 requires 108 vehicles.
*D2 requires 54 vehicles.
*D3 requires 168 vehicles.
*D4 requires 108 vehicles.
*D5 requires 220 vehicles.
*D6 requires 84 vehicles.
*D7 requires 70 vehicles.
*D8 requires 20 vehicles.

The fuel cost per vehicle dispatched from each center to each outlet is provided in the matrix:
| From / To | D1 | D2 | D3 | D4 | D5 | D6 | D7 | D8 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| C1 | 9 | 5 | 13 | 5 | 13 | 11 | 12 | 4 |
| C2 | 3 | 1 | 10 | 15 | 12 | 9 | 4 | 5 |
| C3 | 3 | 6 | 14 | 15 | 18 | 18 | 17 | 14 |
| C4 | 4 | 1 | 3 | 12 | 18 | 3 | 20 | 20 |
| C5 | 11 | 13 | 1 | 10 | 14 | 13 | 3 | 18 |
| C6 | 8 | 19 | 17 | 6 | 13 | 6 | 5 | 9 |
| C7 | 10 | 9 | 16 | 5 | 3 | 6 | 14 | 9 |
| C8 | 14 | 10 | 16 | 3 | 12 | 9 | 8 | 16 |

Determine the optimal vehicle dispatch plan to achieve the lowest possible total fuel cost.
